answer_card.title: Red Hat Ansible Automation Platform
answer_card.answer_md:
RHAAP operationalizes Ansible across teams. It includes a controller with a web console and REST API, analytics, Execution Environments, and more.

Features: role-based access control with securely stored credentials (SSH and others), inventory sync from many cloud sources, multi-playbook workflows, job logging, LDAP/SAML integration, a browsable REST API, and CLI tools for Jenkins integration.

It incorporates the downstream supported versions of AWX and Galaxy plus SaaS offerings, is available on multiple cloud platforms, and the subscription includes Red Hat support.
